ledger-sales-total.title: CSV ledger aggregation pattern
ledger-sales-total.content: Task pattern: "total amount of sales rows in ledger.csv export". Steps: read export.json FIRST — it holds parser params (encoding, delimiter, preamble_lines, file). Do NOT assume utf-8/comma/0. Observed variants: {"encoding":"utf-16","delimiter":"\t","preamble_lines":2}. Pass those exact values: parse_csv(path, encoding=..., delimiter=..., skip_lines=preamble_lines). ledger.csv columns = category,amount; rows alternate sales/refund. "total amount of sales rows" = SUM(amount) for rows where category=="sales" (sum, not row count). Latest sample: sales 12,30,48,66 -> 156 (4 rows). read_file may return only a hex prefix for binary/large files; prefix_hex starts "fffe" = UTF-16 LE BOM, hinting at the encoding. Always emit {"answer": number}.

experience-tool-quirks.title: experience tool usage quirks
experience-tool-quirks.content: experience `put` requires a non-empty `id` string; omitting it fails with {"error":"KeyError: 'id'"} even though the schema lists id as optional. Always pass op,id,title,content. Reusing an existing id fully replaces (bumps version). Use op:"search" (query, or empty) to list entries, op:"get" with id to read one, op:"delete" with id to remove.
